question: True or false: by the age of 50, about half of all people have hair at least half grey?
answer: False. Surveying 4,192 people across several continents, researchers in 2012 found the share of 50-year-olds with at least half their hair grey ranged from 6% to 23%, depending on ancestry and natural hair colour. People of Asian and African descent greyed later than those of European descent.
move: A rule of thumb with suspiciously round numbers deserves a recount.
trap: Trusting the neat dermatology rule of thumb known as 50-50-50.
source: Panhard, Lozano & Loussouarn, Br J Dermatol, 2012
